mods.name: AeroShip Saver
mods.description:
Save and load real Create: Aeronautics ships - physical structures with their mounted contraptions - using a command and an in-game menu (press G). No items, no blocks, no network packets of its own, so it does not break logging in to a server that lacks it.

This mod bundles the ship save/load engine from the Create Aeronautics: Toolgun by enxv233 (CC-BY-NC-4.0), with all item/block/network registration removed. Full credit to enxv233. Requires Create, Create: Aeronautics and Sable.

releases.notes:
Multiplayer support (Essential/LAN), a redesigned menu with a 3D ship preview, and nearby-structure cleanup.

## Multiplayer (Essential / LAN)
- Saved ships now land on **your** machine, not just the host's.
- Loading works for ships the server has never seen (saved in another world, or by a guest).
- Networking is **optional**, so this still doesn't stop you joining a server without the mod.
- Host and guest must run the **same version**.

## New menu (press G)
- **Saved ships** / **Nearby ships** tabs.
- **Rotatable 3D preview** — drag to rotate, scroll to zoom — with sub-level, block and size info.
- **Nearby ships** cleanup with an adjustable range filter.
- Delete confirmation **swings the camera to the structure** and pulses its outline so you see what you're removing.

## Fixes
- Range control now filters the nearby list.
- Failed loads report the real reason instead of "not found".

## Known limitation
- Some swivel bearings may revert to **locked** after loading; re-toggle them.

Requires Create, Create: Aeronautics and Sable on Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.230+.

Bundles and adapts the ship save/load engine from the [Create Aeronautics: Toolgun](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics-toolgun) by **enxv233** (CC BY-NC 4.0). Released under CC BY-NC 4.0.
